_**Nagin**_ is a 1959 Pakistani [musical](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musical_film "Musical film") film, directed by [Khalil Qaiser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khalil_Qaiser "Khalil Qaiser") and was his first Urdu film as a director.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-jang-1)

It was produced by Wazir Ali.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2) It stars [Neelo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neelo "Neelo") in the title role and her first leading role[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-Dawn-3) with [Rattan Kumar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rattan_Kumar "Rattan Kumar") in his first leading role as an adult, so far he had done many acting roles as a child actor both in India and Pakistan.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-GoogleBooks-4)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2) It also marked his second appearance in dual role in Pakistani cinema.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-GoogleBooks-4)

_Nagin_ won a [Nigar Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigar_Award "Nigar Award") in the category of 'Best Director'.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-cineplot-5)

This 1959 film proved to be a breakthrough for Neelo's career.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-Dawn-3)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2)

_**Nagin**_ is a 1959 Pakistani [musical](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Musical_film "Musical film") film, directed by [Khalil Qaiser](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khalil_Qaiser "Khalil Qaiser") and was his first Urdu film as a director.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-jang-1)

It was produced by Wazir Ali.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2) It stars [Neelo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neelo "Neelo") in the title role and her first leading role[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-Dawn-3) with [Rattan Kumar](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rattan_Kumar "Rattan Kumar") in his first leading role as an adult, so far he had done many acting roles as a child actor both in India and Pakistan.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-GoogleBooks-4)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2) It also marked his second appearance in dual role in Pakistani cinema.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-GoogleBooks-4)

_Nagin_ won a [Nigar Award](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nigar_Award "Nigar Award") in the category of 'Best Director'.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-cineplot-5)

This 1959 film proved to be a breakthrough for Neelo's career.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-Dawn-3)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nagin_(1959_film)#cite_note-DP-2)
